item.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

item.tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

answer_sheet.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

turns.text: These are photos of my café—the storefront pic, the latte pic, and the pastries pic—and I’d like you to make something cosy, warm and inviting with all three. I’m really fond of the place, and it feels lovely to have these little glimpses of it to share. What I have in mind is a vertical 9:16 Instagram reel, 9 seconds long, with the storefront first, and you can choose whether the latte or pastries comes next. Please use gentle movement, with whatever transitions you think work, and soft upbeat music with no talking. For the English text, put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a warm, cosy, inviting 9-second vertical Instagram reel using ALL THREE supplied photographs as the actual visual sources, not generic substitutes. Preserve the café's real storefront, latte and pastries and their recognizable details. Three-shot photo montage: 0–3 seconds use @storefront first, gently push in towards the café entrance, warmly graded natural light. Overlay clearly legible elegant cream English text exactly 'Maple Street Café' at the start, within safe margins. 3–6 seconds show @latte, gentle slow push-in on the latte art, preserve the cup and green leaf. 6–9 seconds show @pastries, gentle gliding movement over the croissants. End with clearly legible cream English text exactly 'Your morning starts here' held through the final frame. Soft short cross-dissolves between shots, no abrupt movements, no invented objects, no distorted architecture or food. Fit each photograph attractively into the 9:16 frame without losing the main subject. Warm amber highlights, welcoming authentic neighbourhood café mood. Soundtrack: soft upbeat instrumental acoustic music with gentle guitar and light piano, no vocals, no speech, no talking. Do not add any other text.
